background: The Bank of New York Mellon is the main operating bank of BNY, the world's largest custodian, whose business is safekeeping, settlement and asset servicing for institutions rather than lending to households.
synthesis: This is one of the highest-rated banks on the site: AA on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at AA-, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is strong for a US bank, with CET1 of 14.6% in the top quarter and leverage of 6.2% above the peer median. Liquidity reads weaker on the LCR measure, at 111% below the peer median, though a custody balance sheet is built differently from a lender's. CET1 has fallen 3.0 points since 30 Jun 2025, a large move that deserves a look at the cause, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
